experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM2367735: Input K562 NHS Homo sapiens ChIP-Seq
study_title: Genome-wide maps of histone H4 acetylation in human K562 cells in optimal growth conditions and upon heat stress
description: Illumina HiSeq 2500 sequencing: GSM2367735: Input K562 NHS Homo sapiens ChIP-Seq
library_construction_protocol: After tretments, the cells were cross-linked with 1% fromaldehyde, quenched with glycine, washed twice with PBS and flash-frozen. The ChIP-experiments were conducted as described for GSE43579 (Vihervaara et al., Transcriptional response to stress in the dynamic chromatin environment of cycling and mitotic celss, 2013, PNAS, 110: 36, E3388-3397). The libraries were generated with Nextera DNA Sample Preparation kit (Illumina). Paired-end sequencing (HiSeq PE100) was performed with Illumina.
